mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET auth_epoch = auth_epoch + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{customerId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0 AND lifecycle_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLING')

UPDATE customer SET auth_epoch = auth_epoch + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{customerId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND auth_epoch = #{expectedAuthEpoch} AND lifecycle_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLING')

UPDATE customer SET lifecycle_status = 'CANCELLING', lifecycle_version = lifecycle_version + 1, auth_epoch = auth_epoch + 1, current_lifecycle_operation_no = #{operationNo}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{customerId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' AND lifecycle_version = #{expectedLifecycleVersion} AND current_lifecycle_operation_no IS NULL

UPDATE customer SET phone = #{newPhone}, auth_epoch = auth_epoch + 1, lifecycle_version = lifecycle_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{customerId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' AND lifecycle_version = #{expectedLifecycleVersion} AND current_lifecycle_operation_no IS NULL

UPDATE customer SET is_deleted = 1, auth_epoch = auth_epoch + 1, lifecycle_status = 'CANCELLED', lifecycle_version = lifecycle_version + 1, cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{customerId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' AND lifecycle_version = #{expectedLifecycleVersion}
